# PiTTy v0.5.15

PiTTy v0.5.15 republishes the 0.5.14 diff-wrapping fix with working release archives.

## Release Packaging

- Republished the 0.5.14 change with fresh release archives after the v0.5.14 download assets were unusable for `pitty upgrade`.

## Diff Rendering (from 0.5.14)

- Long lines in expanded tool diffs now wrap onto the next row instead of being clipped at the diff window edge.
